verdicts.rationale: REST v2 insert API accepts vector field as string '"[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]"' instead of proper numeric array format [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]. The API should reject this type mismatch or require proper array format for FloatVector fields. Instead, it accepts the string, stores it, and even successfully searches against it (distance=1 indicates it was processed as a vector). This represents a critical type validation bypass - vector fields are core to Milvus functionality and improper type handling could lead to data corruption, indexing errors, or incorrect search results. Confirmed through successful insert and search operations showing the string value was accepted and processed as a vector.
